search_window.basis: Latest documented prior watch completion was 2026-10-14 15:50:22 PDT; exact intervening hourly persisted checkpoint not verified. Used conservative gap-inclusive window.

focus_classes: emergency food distribution canceled/suspended due to weather/disaster/outage/facility damage
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruption with immediate consequences
queries: "only grocery store" closed OR fire OR destroyed October 14 2026 USA
"last grocery store" closes OR fire OR flood October 14 2026
"sole grocery store" fire OR closes October 14 2026
"food distribution" canceled storm flooding October 14 2026 food bank
"food pantry" canceled distribution power outage October 14 2026

excluded_examples.reason: Prior-week report; not newly published within observation interval.
April 2026 historical closure; outside the interval.
March 2026 historical cancellation; outside interval and different causal class.

coverage_notes.limitation: Search-index publication timestamps are not consistently hour-resolved. This is a bounded supplementary recall watch and is not evidence of zero incidents nationally. Production collector remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.operational_effects: No approvals, publication, schedule changes, task disabling, or production collection changes.
